newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: STIC leases aircraft for US$140 mln.
newsitem.headline: STIC leases aircraft for US$140 mln.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Aerospace (STA) said on Thursday the company and its parent, Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) had entered an US$140 million agreement to lease a Boeing freighter aircraft to Asiana Airlines of South Korea.
STA said in a statement the lease transaction was also entered with Singapore Aircraft Leasing Enterprise (S.A.L.E.), Finlayson Investments and UOB Finance (HK).
The aircraft is scheduled for delivery in mid-December. STA said the lease is for 10 years and is administered by S.A.L.E.
STA's and STIC's involvement in the transaction was carried out through an equally owned joint venture, ST Aviations Resources (STAR).
STAR has a 15 percent stake in the transaction while S.A.L.E holds a 50 percent stake. Finlayson holds a 25 percent stake while UOB Finance the remaining 10 percent.
